topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I just found out that my partner's been writing a novel, and I'm a character in it. Can you believe it? They've been sneaking away to type on their laptop, and I thought they were just catching up on emails or watching videos. Turns out, I've been living in the pages of a story they've been crafting in secret. I mean, it's flattering, right? To be so interesting that someone would write you into their world. I can't wait to read it, see how they see me, how we are in their imagination. It's a bit much, but also kind of amazing.
